title: Chapter 1100
paragraphs: Chapter 1100
Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (4)
Craaack! Kudududu...!
Andrei's flagship, split in half, was falling to the ground.
The crew, aside from him and the adjutant-level mages, all died instantly without even leaving a final scream.
Even though it was just a single flash of a sword.

Those who were not directly touched by the sword, those who were not even touched by the wind pressure created by the sword, all met their death for the sole reason that they were standing in the place where its trajectory remained.
Not a single drop of blood spurted from those who died in such a way.
As if a bone-dry pile of sand were crumbling in a winter wind, their bodies simply decomposed into particles and scattered.

As if they had never existed in that place from the beginning, as if they had never stood there for even a moment, before a few seconds had passed, the dead members of the Demon Army had disappeared without a trace.
That is what happens if one cannot withstand the 'caliber' of the knight named Chiron Runcandel even for a moment.
'This is insane...! What in the world is this dimension!'
To fight back, or to run away.
Once you entered Chiron's range, that was not a matter of choice.
The choice was a thing that was, at best, permitted only to those who were qualified to 'fight' Chiron.
Chwaaaaa-!
A second sword strike hit Andrei's flagship once more.
A diagonal line cutting through the opposite side; by then, the flagship was already in the process of decomposing into particles.
Andrei and his adjutants felt as if their armor had suddenly been stripped away.
The second strike, which flew at their bare skin, was aimed precisely at Andrei's waist.
“Keok!”
The adjutants who had thrown their bodies to protect Andrei first met their deaths.
Although it was a single branch of sword-aura, their bodies were torn into countless branches and then disappeared, becoming particles.
Still, they were those who had withstood Chiron's caliber, even for a moment.
Thanks to them, Andrei was able to receive the blow from Chiron, which had surely been weakened.
“Kahaat...!”
A pain as if his bones were breaking.

He had only blocked a single sword strike, yet it felt as if all the blood in his body was repeatedly freezing and boiling, and the peaceful senses of Andrei, who had not faced a formidable enemy for a long time, were startled and torn.
“That's a real eye-opener, Chiron Runcandel...! Your greeting is excessive.”
“I am confused in many ways, Andrei. The fact that a bastard like you became a Genesis Knight and was steeped in reign, and the fact that you dared to receive my sword... is quite a shock.”
It was the voice of Chiron, who had leaped through the bombardment in the meantime.
Andrei unleashed his wind-element magic to prevent him from getting close, but it was not enough.
Andrei's strategy to avoid close combat had failed.
How he should revise it, a move did not immediately come to mind.
It was a natural result, as he had given Chiron the distance.
“Ha, Chiron Runcandel. You're insane. Do you mean to say you took such a risk just to punish me alone?”
From all directions, precise bombardments were flying towards Chiron.
Some he blocked with a shield, some he struck away with his sword, but Chiron continued to aim only for Andrei.
The sharp wind that Andrei formed would at times graze Chiron's shoulder or thigh.
Chiron smirked at the meaningless, minor scratches.
“I did not come to punish you alone. I have stepped forward to cut down all of you bastards.”
It was impossible.
In Andrei's common sense, Chiron could never keep the words he had spat out.
By the standard of 'all dimensions,' a Genesis Knight usually existed in any world, and the Demon Army had always suppressed them without much difficulty.
“To think you can say such things even after seeing Genesis Knights die like ants to your bombardment. We are merely special soldiers, Chiron Runcandel.”
Although he answered as such, Andrei was doubting himself.
He had received a feeling as if his insides were shriveling up and his mind was being overwhelmed, just like that day when he had first met the Kelliark of the 33rd dimension in the past.
'If it's this Chiron... could it be possible? No, it can't be. Absolutely not!'
For a moment, he was at the point of even thinking such a thought. Soon, Andrei collected himself and glared at Chiron.
The White Fleet, while pressuring Chiron, was also continuing to check the other Genesis Knights to prevent them from getting closer to Andrei.
However, the White Fleet was continuously collapsing under the full-scale advance of the Genesis Knights and the bombardment of the Golden Fleet.
It was just that the front line of the White Fleet was not breaking, as they were being replaced as much as they were being shot down.
Rather, the White Fleet was slowly expanding its front line.
From five hundred to five hundred fifty, then back to five hundred, then to five hundred seventy.
Thanks to that, Andrei was managing to maintain a form of giving and taking blows with Chiron quite plausibly.
Sword and staff, aura and magic were leaving afterimages in the middle of the sky that were larger than the disappeared flagship.
Strange.
The fact that he was trading blows reasonably well with a person with whom there was a clear gap was driving Andrei into a sense of unease.

'Is it because I have ascended to a Genesis Knight and have obtained the power to twist fate? That's not it. Chiron, this man is now... gauging... What? Don't tell me he's really gauging whether he can cut us all down?'
This man still sees us as mere prey!
Unfathomably arrogant.
“Even after knowing that the world is not one, and therefore knowing the fact that you are no longer the strongest! Do you still proclaim yourself to be the heavens alone? Do you dare to do so!”
Of all the Genesis Knights of this world, only Chiron had not met Kelliark, so he must be acting like this; if not for that, there was no way he could be like this.
So to speak, Andrei was feeling a displeasure as if Kelliark and the entire Demon Army had been insulted.
That a man who was nothing more than a mere special soldier still considered himself to be the heavens.
Furthermore, Chiron, as if he had finished his gauging, was slowly retrieving his storming sword and seemed to be more conscious of the fleet surrounding him and Andrei.
And once again, Andrei suddenly realized that there were too many white ships gathered nearby.
Even without Chiron, there were four Genesis Knights in this place, and one of them was the Battle Goddess Vahn.
The fact that the fleet had maintained its encirclement so intact even though those four had closed the distance at once was strange.
'Why didn't they scatter them more? They could have scattered them more. If they had done so, they could have also prevented our front line from expanding, so why in the world?'
A series of doubts and questions.
While he was unable to read his opponent's thoughts at all, Andrei met Chiron's eyes.
Those eyelids, opened wide like a beast about to bite into the nape of its prey's neck.
“This is the Black Sea, Andrei Zipple.”
Gededeudeudeuk...!
Suddenly, a dark and heavy sound of rupture erupted, as if the kings of the Black Sea were roaring.
Andrei reflexively lowered his head. It was a sound that had come up from the ground, no, from somewhere in the underground of the abyss-like deep Black Sea.
“And I am the only human who has conquered this land.”
“Ah!”
Jjeeeeeoook...!
The land that spread out below Chiron and Andrei, that vast earth, was seen splitting apart as if it were a lie.
The earth had opened its maw like a predator. In fact, the cross-section was even densely sprouted with fangs, just like the mouth of a beast.
“It means that the Black Sea is now mine.”
The sight of the Black Sea's maw leaping up towards the sky, just like a single giant whale, followed.
At the scenery he had never once seen while conquering those numerous dimensions, at the sight he had never even imagined, Andrei madly turned his head and looked in all directions.
It was not just one.
The maws that had opened at Chiron's will were spread out like an endless cliff below all the fleets that were protecting Andrei, and were shooting up.
Kwajik, Kwajik, Keudeudeuk!
“Kraaaaaak!”
Andrei let out a scream-like battle cry and exploded his magic in all directions.
His vision was dyed completely black as he had entered the Black Sea's maw.
A heavy shadow energy that he had never experienced before was also crushing his entire body.
'Have the nearby fleets also been swallowed whole? What is this... why in the world is Chiron Runcandel using Chaos!'
Contrary to his thoughts, Chiron was not wielding Chaos.
As he had said himself, he had just defeated all the kings of the Black Sea and was newly ruling this place.
The power that Chiron had obtained was not Chaos, but the Black Sea itself.
Naturally, the Black Sea did not inflict any damage on Chiron himself and the other Genesis Knights of the coalition that it had swallowed together.
Of course, the coalition's Genesis Knights had been informed by Chiron that he had obtained this power.
That was why they had deliberately driven the enemies so that the Black Sea could eat them easily.
The white fleets were sinking into the abyss of the Black Sea.
Although it could not wipe out the entire fleet at once like the Plutonian Cannon, for the Demon Army, this was, in a way, more terrifying.
Because it might not be an instant death.
After all, even the Demon Army had not finished all their analysis on the Black Sea.
“Keuhak, Chiiirooon...!”
The enraged shout of Andrei echoed emptily within the Black Sea's maw.
He was already exposed to Chaos all over his body, and if it weren't for the energy of a Genesis Knight, he would have already been in a fatal state.
Andrei could not grasp the damage status of the Demon Army. He could not read the direction from which Chiron's sword was flying.
Defense and counterattack relying on the insight of a Genesis Knight; that was all Andrei could do.
Nevertheless, if he were given enough time, he might be able to find an answer. Because that was the dignity of the realm of a Genesis Knight.
However, Vahn and Luna, Jin and Murakan. The remaining four Genesis Knights were beginning to stir up the enemy lines in earnest.
The one they judged they must kill first was, of course, Andrei.
“Andrei Zipple, you meet your death at my hands for a second time.”
Crimson Sword.
From within the darkness of the Black Sea, a single line of crimson sword-aura passed through Andrei's neck.
Andrei could not help but meet his death without even perceiving that sword.
Because from all directions, Genesis Knights stronger than him were pressuring him.
Keudeuk, keudeudeuk....
The maws of the Black Sea did not show any sign of stopping even after swallowing Andrei and about a hundred ships.
Rondo Zipple and the executives, who were watching the battle situation from inside the dimensional gate, could not help but tremble.
“Ha! Chiron Runcandel controlling the Black Sea? Something like that didn't exist in any other dimension. This is driving me mad.”
Rondo Zipple only answered the executive's words like this.
“...Compared to his sword, an authority like commanding the Black Sea... is nothing more than a trivial trick.”
